# Getting help

| You need… | Where |
|---|---|
| the user guide | [documentation](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/blob/main/docs/README.md) |
| a fix for a common problem | [troubleshooting](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/blob/main/docs/en/macos/troubleshooting.md) |
| an answer to a question | [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/discussions/categories/q-a) |
| to report a bug or an idea | [new issue](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/issues/new/choose) |
| to report a security issue | privately, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/blob/main/SECURITY.md) |

ClipRecorder is a hobby project, so replies may take a little while. English and Polish are both welcome.

**Po polsku:** [dokumentacja](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/blob/main/docs/pl/macos/README.md) ·
[rozwiązywanie problemów](https://github.com/ItsRaelx/ClipRecorder/blob/main/docs/pl/macos/problemy.md) ·
pytania i zgłoszenia można pisać po polsku.
